skill.name: wecomcli-calendar
skill.description: Manage WeCom calendar schedules, attendee availability, and meeting room bookings through wecom-cli. Online meetings are handled by a separate skill.
skill.summary: Create, find, update, and cancel WeCom schedules while coordinating attendees and room availability.
skill.author: wecomteam

security_audit.summary: All 172 static alerts are false positives involving Markdown links, backticks, business identifiers, and readable multilingual documentation. One semantic concern is the unverified assumption of prior confirmation before calendar writes. No evidence found of credential exfiltration, hidden payloads, or malicious prompt injection in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Calendar writes assume that an upstream interaction already confirmed the final operation.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit authorization for the resolved target and final parameters, or verify an upstream confirmation record before creating, updating, or cancelling schedules.

content.user_title: Manage WeCom Schedules and Room Bookings
content.value_statement: Coordinating calendars, participants, and meeting rooms requires several separate checks. This skill guides compatible assistants through WeCom CLI workflows for schedules, availability, and room bookings.
actual_capabilities: Create single schedules with attendees, optional reminders, locations, and explicit time zones.
Browse schedules by date and retrieve individual schedule details.
Search schedules by keywords, organizer, or attendees, including paginated results.
Update or cancel nonrecurring schedules, with permissions enforced by the service.
Query individual or shared availability and present time options with participant conflicts.
Find accessible buildings and available meeting rooms, then book or change rooms through schedule writes.
limitations: Requires an installed wecom-cli, authorized WeCom access, and the shared prerequisite skill; contact resolution and online meetings require companion skills.
Cannot create, update, or cancel recurring schedules, or accept, decline, or tentatively respond to invitations.
Schedule browsing is limited to 30 days before or after the current time.
Availability queries require windows of 24 hours or less and can miss recurring schedules unchanged for more than two months.

use_cases.title: Review a Personal Workday
use_cases.description: Check upcoming schedules and see subjects, times, and participant names in a concise agenda.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a Team Review
use_cases.description: Resolve participant names, compare availability, and create a single review schedule after choosing a suitable time.

use_cases.title: Arrange Office Space
use_cases.description: Find an available room with suitable capacity and attach it to a new or existing schedule.

prompt_templates.title: View Today's Agenda
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my WeCom schedules for today, ordered by start time.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Schedule
prompt_templates.prompt: Find my WeCom schedules with Product Review in the subject. Show the times and participants.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: locate an event by keyword.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a New Schedule
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a WeCom schedule titled Design Review with Alice Chen and Bob Li tomorrow afternoon for 45 minutes. Show available start times first.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: resolve attendees and select a shared time.

prompt_templates.title: Reschedule and Change Rooms
prompt_templates.prompt: Find tomorrow's nonrecurring Design Review schedule. Move it one hour later, check attendee availability, and find a bookable room for everyone. Let me choose among alternatives.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: update an existing schedule and its room booking.

output_examples.input: Show my WeCom schedules for October 23.
Find a shared hour for Alice Chen, Bob Li, and me tomorrow afternoon.

output_examples.output: Cancelling recurring schedules is not supported. Please cancel it in the WeCom client.

best_practices: Provide an explicit subject, participant names, date, duration, and time zone when relevant.
Resolve ambiguous participants and schedules before writing; confirm the final operation when prior authorization is unclear.
Use returned availability and room candidates, and approve alternatives when the requested time or room is unavailable.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a meeting room name in the location field as a confirmed room booking.
Do not cancel and recreate an event to reschedule it, especially when it contains an online meeting link.
Do not simulate recurring schedules through repeated single-event writes or unsupported parameters.

faq.question: What must be installed before using this skill?
faq.answer: You need wecom-cli, authorized WeCom access, and the wecomcli-shared prerequisite checks. Contact lookup requires wecomcli-contact.

faq.question: Can it create online meetings with joining links?
faq.answer: No. Online meetings are routed to wecomcli-meeting. Ambiguous creation requests require clarification before either workflow runs.

faq.question: Can it manage recurring schedules or invitation responses?
faq.answer: It can display recurring schedule information, but cannot create, update, or cancel recurring schedules. Invitation responses require the WeCom client.

faq.question: How far can it browse my calendar?
faq.answer: Schedule list queries cover the 30 days before and after the current time. Out-of-range requests require a shorter supported range.

faq.question: Does naming a room reserve it?
faq.answer: No. The workflow must find a bookable room and pass its returned identifier into schedule creation or update.

faq.question: Will it ask before changing my calendar?
faq.answer: It asks about missing information and ambiguous choices. Once parameters are ready, the documented workflow executes writes without a final confirmation.
